INQU.name: Counters Inquiry
INQU.definition: Counters since the last counters inquiry.

BDAY.name: Business Day
BDAY.definition: Counters since the beginning of the business day.

PRTN.name: Operation
PRTN.definition: Counters as a result of some replenishment operation carried out by an operator (for example adding cash to a cash unit).

OPER.name: Operator Adjust
OPER.definition: Counters since the last update by an operator on the ATM.
